session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Higher High Double Top Then Bear Trending Trading Range Day'. After a higher high double top at 4176, a small pullback bear trend breaks below the opening trading range toward 4147 and the day becomes a bear trending trading range with an expanding triangle afternoon around 4140; a lower low double bottom at 4120 lifts the close to 4137.
